parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6 (val_bpb 1.0256). Scaling capacity to depth 16 seems too unstable for the 5-minute window without massive batch sizes or very specific LR schedules. I'll try finding a middle ground by increasing MATRIX_LR slightly while keeping DEPTH=6 to see if it helps convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and slightly increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.06 to improve convergence within the 5-minute limit, building on the successful depth increase.
